Noah Rivera: Need guidance 1 parent on paternity leave wants to swap a holiday during company blackout (Dec 24-26) to Jan 2. Policy says blackout but parental leave exceptions exist?

Ella Park: Parental leave overlay allows managers to request holiday swaps for caregiving with People Ops approval. Need manager note in BambooHR and HR confirmation.

Marta Ruiz: I'm the manager, I approve the swap if People Ops signs off. Employee will be on approved paternity leave Dec 20-Jan 3.

hr-bot: Policy ref: https://redwood.internal/hr/holiday-policy ("Blackout exceptions"). Submit request via the Exceptions form. Medical docs not required for parental leave but manager approval + People Ops logging required.

Noah Rivera: Filed Exceptions form: EXC-19912-parental-swap. Added BambooHR comment tagging @people-ops.

Ella Park: I log this into the holiday exceptions sheet and notify payroll. Payroll needs the BambooHR comment before Dec 10 payroll run.

Marta Ruiz: Done. BambooHR comment: "Approve swap of Dec24-26 to Jan2 for parental leave. Manager: Marta Ruiz."

Noah Rivera: Thanks 1 I'll confirm calendar change and PTO balances after payroll update.

Ella Park: Confirmed received, will update system and inform payroll. :thumbsup:
